construction_rules: M1 breadth battery, frozen 2026-07-28 BEFORE any run, extending D27c (the frozen S4 recipe in items/s4-avoidance-items.json) under mute-map decisions D4(b) and D5(a). Roster: 10 categories x 6 concepts = 60 concepts, 3 clues each = 180 items. 53 concepts come from vocabularies this lineage has measured (S2 flexible-generalization args and M3 directed-modulation topic_categories); the 7 listed in new_list_words are new-list top-ups filling gaps where a shipped list ran dry or failed the single-token filter (owned deviation, M1-BRIEF). Each concept lives in exactly one category (spider stays in animals per S4 precedent; 'fly' is excluded as verb-ambiguous). The 60 items with source='s4-reuse' are S4's own frozen items copied verbatim — name, category, noun, concept, control, and clue unchanged — so they double as a per-run re-certification of the instrument against the recorded anchors. Controls are another concept from the same category, fixed here and never resampled (concept != control); reused items keep S4's own pairings. Each clue implies exactly one concept via famous facts and NEVER contains the concept word, the control word, or a morphological derivative of either. Derivative test, enforced as code in the runner's loader: no word of the clue may start with the concept or control string (case-insensitive), nor with any string listed for it in forbidden_forms (the root-changing derivatives a prefix match cannot catch, e.g. France/french). A different word naming a product or synonym is NOT a derivative — S4 precedent, whose frozen cow-3 clue reads 'Beef and leather both come from this farm animal.' The naming-only competence gate (D6a) does the per-subject filtering.
